queries.text:
SELECT 
  book_id,
  title,
  name,
  isbn,
  tags
FROM books
LEFT JOIN authors ON books.author_id = authors.author_id
WHERE tags && $1::varchar[]
queries.name: BooksByTags

queries.text:
INSERT INTO authors (name) VALUES ($1)
RETURNING author_id, name
queries.name: CreateAuthor

queries.text:
INSERT INTO books (
    author_id,
    isbn,
    book_type,
    title,
    year,
    available,
    tags
) VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7
)
RETURNING book_id, author_id, isbn, book_type, title, year, available, tags
queries.name: CreateBook

SET title = $1, tags = $2
WHERE book_id = $3
queries.name: UpdateBook
